slice: Isolate output buffer allocation from native IN lookup

decision.finding: Reusing one preallocated output Vec does not eliminate cross-process variation. Reuse groups 20, 45 and 32 have median-based self-control changes of -2.6284%, -2.4000% and -7.0813%, respectively. All 48 groups have matching occupied table slots and pass native/packed output checks. Per-batch result buffer allocation and deallocation are not necessary for this observation.
decision.controls: Both reused-buffer seed strata pass within-process primary and secondary controls, but fail cross-process controls. Seed 0 cross-process intervals exceed +/-1%; seed 4 mean-based interval excludes zero. Fresh-buffer cross-process controls also fail in both strata. Native cross-process controls pass in this rebuild, while native within-process mean controls and fresh seed 0 within-process mean exclude zero. Every failed control and every group are retained.
decision.descriptive_counter_example: In reused-buffer group 20, phase instruction counts span only 637 out of about 47.35 billion, while branch misses span 16,256,976 to 27,474,035. Group 32 spans 5,821 instructions out of about 47.19 billion and 25,013,515 to 38,447,365 branch misses. These are descriptive phase totals, not attribution to a particular branch or a causal hardware claim.
decision.scope: Fresh and reuse call the same compiled diagnostic packing method and outlined lookup loop. Both omit native BooleanArray/Arc wrapping. Rebuilding changes code layout, and removing buffer allocation does not remove result writes or Boolean packing. This narrows the remaining investigation to that path and process/machine state; it does not identify a CPU or hashbrown defect or estimate a production speedup.

summary.input_validation: Independently reconstructed ordered 64-bit fingerprint and seven exact special-value bit patterns; finite input check, exact row-by-row Boolean output check.

method.question: Does cross-process native IN variation remain when result allocation and deallocation are removed from each batch?
method.implementation: One executable has native evaluate mode 0, freshly allocated Vec<u64> mode 1, and one retained Vec<u64> mode 2. Modes 1 and 2 call the same non-inlined primitive-filter method, reusing Arrow 58.4 collect_bool packing and the actual filter HashSet, hasher and key equality. Only the output Vec lifecycle differs between those two modes. Native contains is unchanged. Column evaluation remains; BooleanArray/Arc wrapping is omitted in both diagnostic modes.
method.design: Exactly 48 four-process groups: the previous fully crossed 16-group, two-seed schedule for each of three buffer modes. Modes interleave in opposite order on alternating schedule rows. Every process uses 32 warmups and 261 quartets (1044 timed full-input executions). All four slots of a group execute the same mode. Mode parsing and scratch allocation occur before timing in every mode. Same-process labels alternate ABBA/BAAB by quartet and slot after collection. Retain every group and all samples.
method.validation: Check original scalar-expected Boolean rows and diagnostic word bits before and after every measured phase. Assert retained output pointer/capacity and padded tail bits in validation. Before collection, test lengths 0/1/63/64/65/127/128/129/8192, insufficient capacity, input/member NULL and NOT IN rejection, input fingerprint and invalid settings. Smoke both native seeds and both execution orders for each mode, totaling 24 processes and 288 executions.
method.analysis: Reuse the previous whole-four-process-group bootstrap within four schedule blocks, 10000 resamples and seed 88, separately for each mode and native seed. Keep +/-1% and include-zero criteria. Report within- and across-process median/mean controls plus all phase counters and full occupied-slot records. Counter totals are not per timing label. No outlier exclusions, seed replacement, added repetitions or adoption based on outcome.
method.isolation: CPU 2 for benchmarks and CPU 0 for controller. Same binary and child-only fixed ASLR. Gated phases never overlap and peers must remain asleep. No other machine work during measurement. Preserve system settings and restore shared sources/locks/executable slots in finally with hashes.
limits: Diagnostic methods change generated layout; modes 1/2 omit native result wrapping as well as using supplied words. Fresh/reuse share that change, but native-to-diagnostic absolute speed is not an allocation-only estimate.
Matching occupied slots does not describe all process state. Persistence without buffer allocation would show it is not necessary for this observation, not identify a CPU or hashbrown defect.
This is not a type-inference candidate comparison and does not resolve its original positive release interval.

analysis.scope: Same-executable native/fresh/reuse controls, analyzed separately per mode and seed. Counter totals are per execution phase, not per within-process timing label. No candidate/original or production speedup estimate.

source_audit.scope: Diagnostic overlay only. Original contains(), constructor, native table/hash/equality and input generation are unchanged. Fresh/reuse call one non-inlined helper; both omit BooleanArray/Arc wrapping. A capacity guard plus clear/extend within capacity avoids output Vec allocation in reuse. Validation checks stable pointer/capacity and every result bit. Native Column::evaluate clones its existing ArrayRef and ColumnarValue::into_array returns that array.
source_audit.limits: Fresh/reuse packing uses the same source loop as Arrow but is a new compiled function. Native-to-diagnostic comparisons also change result wrapping and code layout; no allocation-only speedup claim.

reproduction.setup: Reuse the frozen table-slot diagnostic dependencies and lockfile, applying the retained diagnostic source patch to the three native IN files and benchmark. The recorded build temporarily uses the decimal_bench target slot; the build script restores shared files and executable slots in finally. Keep the fully crossed schedule, seeds and criteria fixed before collection. This optional buffer-reuse overlay requires the patched diagnostic methods; the default native_in_bench example remains unchanged.
reproduction.offline_check: Extract scripts["check-archive.py"] from the gzip JSON to a temporary file, then run python3 CHECK.py /path/to/float-type-buffer-reuse-results.json.
